mappings.assertion: TestS1SizeGuard (run by make lint) fails on a stale ratchet entry for a function no longer above 100 lines. proceedInner, proceedManyToOneInner and recoverCrashedTransition are now orchestration over private steps (admitTransitionSource, selectedTransitionTask, generateTransitionChildren, recordGeneratedTransition, requireCohortReady, repairExistingCohortChild, recoverPerSubtask/OneToOne/ManyToOne, classifyRecovery, patchSurvivor), their three keys are removed from area_a4_test.go, and the guard passes; before the keys were removed the same guard failed naming exactly those three entries as stale, which is the negative proof. The proceed.go file key is lowered from 2052 to its measured 1114 lines.

TestRecoveryRecreatesChildIdenticalToFreshGeneration generates three children (plain, sibling plus concrete dependency, selective inherit_inputs), deletes the selective child and recovers: the recreated task is reflect.DeepEqual to the freshly generated one. Negative proof: making recreate use the whole-phase inherited set instead of the per-entry step failed it on DependsOn and it was restored. The existing white-box recovery, dedup, selective-input and inherited-dependency tests in proceed_test.go, selective_inputs_test.go, d88_review_regressions_test.go and plan_amendment_fence_test.go run unchanged apart from the cardinality call-site conversion.

TestOracleProceedExpansion adds the seven goldens (one_to_one, many_to_one, many_to_one_incomplete, selective_inheritance, kind_dedup, recovery_missing_child, recovery_complete) in an oracle-only commit that precedes every production edit; regen -mode check -pkg ./internal/oracle/a4 reproduces them and every older A4 golden, which are untouched.

TestManyToOneHistoryRecordsCardinalityAsString and TestManyToOneRecoveryRecreatesChildAndRecordsCohort assert the many-to-one history cardinality is the plain string many-to-one in generation and recovery; TestUnsupportedCardinalityDispatch asserts an out-of-set cardinality is refused by generation and reported as already executed by recovery. transitionDef.cardinality is models.TransitionCardinality and every cardinality comparison in generation, recovery, isTransitionIncomplete and computeInheritedDeps uses the models constants; the manual-trigger check uses models.TransitionTriggerManual and the replanned marker in computeInheritedDeps uses models.ReplannedTransition. Negative proof: spelling the history value m2o, and letting the dispatch accept an extra cardinality, each failed the intended test and were restored.
TestOracleProceed and TestOracleAutoTransitions run live against their unchanged goldens, as do the A3 and A5 oracles that expand transitions, under make test.

TestEveryRatchetKeyIsInTheSnapshotOnceAndPlacedInOneArea and TestS1SizeGuard (make lint) pass with the proceedInner, proceedManyToOneInner and recoverCrashedTransition keys removed and the proceed.go file ceiling lowered to 1114; the Proceed and ExecuteTransitionsReportWith keys are untouched for Task 2.
test target (go test ./...) runs the ops, archguard and oracle suites including the new tests; lint, test-e2e, the ops race run and the A4 regeneration check are mandatory with it.
